descriptionChirho: To bring, fetch, or convey someone or something toward the speaker or a specified destination, the most common active transitive sense. Includes bringing people (the sick, children, a prisoner) and objects (food, tribute). Arb أَحْضِرُوا / يَأْتُونَ, deu bringen, heb הֵבִיאוּ / הָבִיאוּ, hin लाओ / लाते, kor 가져오라 / 데려오다, spa traer / traed. See Matt 14:11,18; 17:17; Mark 1:32; 2:3; 6:27-28; 7:32; 8:22; 9:17,19-20; 11:2,7; 12:15-16; Luke 15:22-23; John 2:8; 4:33; 18:29; 19:39; 21:10; Acts 4:34,37; 5:2,16; 14:13; 2 Tim 4:11,13; 2 John 10.

To carry, bear, or transport a physical object or person from one place to another, emphasizing the physical act of bearing weight or conveying across distance. Used of carrying the sick on pallets, Simon carrying the cross, women carrying spices, sustaining all things by divine power. Arb حامِلين / يَحْمِلُكَ, deu bringen, heb נוֹשְׂאִים / לָשֵׂאת, hin उठाते / ले जाएगा, kor 운반하는 / 지며, spa llevando / trayendo. See Luke 5:18; 23:26; 24:1; John 2:8,12; 21:18; Heb 1:3; 13:13; 2 Pet 1:21.

To bear fruit, yield produce, or bring forth results, used literally of agricultural productivity (seed, vines) and figuratively of spiritual fruitfulness. Central to Jesus's vine/branches discourse in John 15. Arb يَحْمِلُ / أَثْمَرَ, deu bringen, heb נוֹשֵׂא / הֵבִיאוּ, hin लाता है / लाने वाली, kor 맺는다 / 맺도록, spa lleva / llevéis. See Mark 4:8; John 12:24; 15:2(x3),4,5,8,16; Col 1:6,10.

To bear with, endure, or tolerate something difficult, burdensome, or painful, whether divine patience with sinners or human inability to withstand. Arb تَحَمَّلَ / يَحْتَمِلُوا, deu bringen, heb נָשָׂא / נָשְׂאוּ, hin सहा / सह सकते थे, kor 참으셨다 / 견딜 수, spa soportó / soportaban. See Rom 9:22; Heb 12:20; 13:13.

labelChirho: drive along, be carried by force
descriptionChirho: To be driven, carried along, or impelled by an external force such as wind, current, or the Holy Spirit, often in the passive/middle voice. Used of a rushing wind at Pentecost, a ship driven by storm, a gate leading somewhere, and pressing on toward maturity. Arb مَحْمُولَة / لِنَنْطَلِقْ, deu bringt, heb נוֹשֶׁבֶת / נִסְחַפְנוּ, hin तेज़ / बढ़ें, kor 세차게 / 나아가자, spa siendo llevado / seamos llevados. See Acts 2:2; 12:10; 27:15,17; Heb 6:1; 2 Pet 1:21; Jude 12.
